summary: Linked-list destructor with a two-level data free. Walks the list from the head in *this, reading each node's next pointer at +0x4 and free-data flag at +0x8. For each node whose flag is non-zero and whose outer data pointer at +0x0 is non-null, it frees the inner allocation referenced by data[0] and then the outer data block itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Every node is then freed. Finally the list bookkeeping fields (head, tail, current, count) are zeroed and 0 is returned.

operations.description: Traverse the singly-linked list from the head stored at *this while the current node pointer is non-null.
Capture the node's outer data pointer (v5 = *v3) and free flag (node+0x8) before advancing to the next node via node+0x4.
Per node: free the attached data only when the free-data flag at node+0x8 is non-zero AND the outer data pointer at node+0x0 is non-null.
Free the inner allocation referenced by data[0] (*(*v3)) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the outer data block v5 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf on every iteration.
Zero the list head, tail, current and count fields at this+0x0, +0x4, +0x8 and +0xC.
Return 0 after the list is emptied.
